scope: POSTHOC bounded Gaussian-code MAP regularization diagnosis on first8 already-used cosine taper7.5 systems, motivated by q768 oracle/deployment gap. Same rank768 q-PCA, same 1024 training labels and 60/100/140 Hz observations, fixed 5+5 GN and prior strengths 0/1e-6/1e-4/1e-2; no true test medium or target in inference. Zero-strength MUST reproduce original q768 deployment on eight systems before interpreting positives. Query outcomes select no formal method; all are development-only. Strength tunes could further improve q, so failure of this bounded sweep is not impossibility of q modeling.
